5822.title: Cancelled hooks are misclassified as daemon failures
5822.rootCauseOneLine: The pre-dispatch cancellation branch throws a generic Error, so the RPC router logs an expected outcome as a warning with an Error stack.
5822.proposedFix: Use the existing expected-dispatch error class for the cancelled marker, preserving the current RPC error code/message and compact debug logging.
5822.caveats: Verified twice at the RPC boundary. Production message counts and the upstream scheduling cause were not investigated. Test and both transcripts are embedded in the self-contained HTML per report-repository policy.
